definitions.explanation: A climbing vine with cascading clusters of fragrant purple or white flowers. Wisteria is a beloved symbol of late spring in Japan.

notes:
{藤|ふじ} refers to wisteria.

Common expressions:
- ⟦{藤棚|ふじだな}→藤棚：noentry⟧ (wisteria trellis/arbor)
- {藤|ふじ}⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ (light purple, wisteria color)
- {藤|ふじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧ (wisteria flowers)
- {藤|ふじ}⟦{紫|むらさき}→紫：00297_murasaki⟧ (wisteria purple)

Counter: ⟦{株|かぶ}→株：02592_kabu⟧ (for the plant itself)

Cultural note:
Wisteria blooms in late April to early May. Famous wisteria viewing spots include Ashikaga Flower Park (Tochigi), Kawachi Wisteria Garden (Fukuoka), and Kasuga Taisha (Nara). The {藤|ふじ} family crest ({藤|ふじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紋|もん}→紋：13863_mon⟧) was used by the powerful Fujiwara clan. {藤|ふじ} is also a common element in Japanese surnames like ⟦{藤田|ふじた}→藤田：noentry⟧, ⟦{藤井|ふじい}→藤井：noentry⟧, ⟦{佐藤|さとう}→佐藤：27597_satou⟧, etc.
